title: Among users from California who have obtained the “Supporter” badge, find t
question: Among users from California who have obtained the “Supporter” badge, find the user whose posts have the highest total view count in the year 2012 and return that user’s display name (DisplayName).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055" AS "DisplayName"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_033"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'California'
  AND T2."XCL_003" = 'Supporter'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_029") = '2012'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_030") DESC
LIMIT 1
